Docs.summary: Provides types to configure and manage IKEv2 sessions and their IPsec Child sessions.

remarks.para: Use to configure the IKE peer, authentication, and security association proposals. Use tunnel-mode or transport-mode Child session parameters to propose traffic selectors and IPsec security associations.
Session configuration and callback types report the negotiated results. Proposed algorithms, supported algorithms, and negotiated algorithms describe different stages of session setup.
